    What We Handle

    Six practice areas.
    One advisor per file.

    The statutory work an Indian business meets from incorporation onward: SPICe+ and LLP formation, GSTIN and monthly GSTR-1 and 3B returns, TM-A trademark filings, FSSAI, BIS and CPCB licences, ISO certification, and FEMA and SEBI reporting once foreign or listed capital is involved.

    Each matter goes to one CA, CS or advocate. They prepare the documents, file with the department, follow the SRN or ARN through the queue and hand you the certificate. You deal with the same person throughout.

    Common Questions

    Before you hand over
    a filing

    Almost everyone asks the same six things before they send us a document. The answers are here, so you have them before anyone calls you.

    Question not here?

    Ask an advisor directly — no form to fill first.

    WhatsApp us · +91 98765 43210

    Two clocks run on every filing. Ours is the time to collect your documents, draft the forms and submit — usually 2 to 4 working days once we have everything. The department's is the queue after submission: about 7 to 10 working days for a SPICe+ incorporation, 5 to 7 for a GSTIN, and months for a trademark to move from TM-A filing to registration. We quote both separately, so you are never told 'a week' for something the registrar will hold for six.

    For most filings: PAN and Aadhaar for every director, partner or proprietor, a recent passport-size photograph, and proof of address no older than two months. For the registered office we need a utility bill — electricity, water or gas — plus a rent agreement and the owner's NOC if the premises are not yours. The exact list for each service is on its page, under Documents required.

    No. We arrange a Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate for each signatory through a licensed certifying authority; issuance takes a short video KYC on your phone and usually completes the same day. Every form is then signed with the DSC or Aadhaar e-sign and filed online.

    If the department raises a query or objection — a REG-03 on GST, an MCA resubmission, an examination report on a trademark — we draft and file the reply at no extra professional fee. If an application is rejected because of an error on our side, we re-file at our cost, including any government fee that has to be paid again. If it is rejected on merits we warned you about in writing, or because a document you supplied was incorrect, the re-filing is quoted fresh before we start.

    A named advisor — a Chartered Accountant, Company Secretary or advocate depending on the filing — owns your file from scoping to handover, and reviews every form before it goes out. You get their direct number. Drafting support works under them, but nothing is submitted without their sign-off.

    Everything the department issues: the Certificate of Incorporation with PAN, TAN and DINs, the GST registration certificate, or the trademark acknowledgement and later the registration certificate, as the case may be — along with login credentials for each portal we set up. At handover we also send the next statutory due dates for your entity, such as INC-20A, the first board meeting, or your first GSTR-1 and 3B.

    How We Work

    Four steps, one advisor

    1. 1

      Scope the filing

      We confirm which forms apply and what documents you need, and send a written quote before any payment.

    2. 2

      Collect and verify

      Your advisor checks every document against the registrar's current checklist, so it isn't rejected on a technicality.

    3. 3

      File and track

      We submit, note the SRN, and follow the queue. You see the status without asking for it.

    4. 4

      Hand over

      Certificate, acknowledgement and a note on what's due next, all in one place.
